lyrics.pop_love: python music_creator.py generate lyrics --genre pop --theme love --rhyme-scheme ABAB --num-verses 2
lyrics.rock_rebellion: python music_creator.py generate lyrics --genre rock --theme rebellion --rhyme-scheme AABB
lyrics.hiphop_success: python music_creator.py generate lyrics --genre hip_hop --theme success --rhyme-scheme FREE

music.pop_song: python music_creator.py generate music --genre pop --key C --bpm 120 --duration 32
music.rock_song: python music_creator.py generate music --genre rock --key D --bpm 140 --duration 64
music.blues_song: python music_creator.py generate music --genre blues --key G --bpm 80 --duration 48

synthesize_examples.with_voice_cloning: python music_creator.py synthesize lyrics --lyrics-file data/generated/lyrics.txt --speaker-wav reference_voice.wav
synthesize_examples.complete_song: python music_creator.py synthesize song --lyrics-file data/generated/lyrics.txt --midi-file data/generated/music.mid

full_workflow: python music_creator.py generate lyrics --genre pop --theme freedom --num-verses 2
python music_creator.py generate music --genre pop --key C --bpm 120
python music_creator.py synthesize song --lyrics-file data/generated/pop_freedom_lyrics.txt --midi-file data/generated/pop_C_120bpm.mid
